fix-parse-edge.query.js:
function parseQuery(q) { const out = {}; q = q.replace(/^\?/, ''); if (!q) return out; for (const pair of q.split('&')) { const [k, v = ''] = pair.split('='); out[decodeURIComponent(k)] = decodeURIComponent(v); } return out; }
module.exports = { parseQuery };

function formatList(items, o = {}) { if (!o.conjunction || items.length < 2) return items.join(', '); return items.slice(0, -1).join(', ') + ' ' + o.conjunction + ' ' + items[items.length - 1]; }
module.exports = { formatList };
